children: Nillion's Darkfall phase is planned for November 2026, bringing Covenants to multiple EVM chains. The announced rollout includes chain-specific nodes and tooling to support Covenants on the chains covered by the expansion.

The expansion would broaden the network in which nodes stake NIL and earn fees. Its implication for staking demand comes from extending that node model across more EVM chains, with infrastructure tailored to each chain rather than only a general integration announcement. The roadmap gives investors a target month for tracking this extension, but the scope and timing remain unconfirmed. It is therefore a planned expansion of staking participation, not evidence of increased demand already occurring.
The launch of Dusk is just the beginning.

title: Nillion: Darkfall extends Covenants across multiple EVM chains - Nov 2026
